name: Shenzhen Boshijie Technology Co Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Boshijie Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the comprehensive lifecycle of smart hardware products for the Internet of Things (IoT), from their initial conception and engineering to manufacturing and market distribution. Their offerings include a variety of specialized items like vehicle positioning systems, monitoring terminals, payment-related hardware, intelligent travel devices, and wireless communication components. This enterprise was founded on June 4, 2009, by Xiao Qiang Zhou, Rong Tian Jiang, Ming Ying Chen, and Zhi Qiang Guan, and maintains its principal offices in Shenzhen, China.
